newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends mostly up, housing reaction mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends mostly up, housing reaction mixed.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed mostly higher on sentiment the sharp drop in prices earlier in the week may have been overdone, traders said.
Floor sources noted Cargill Investor Services was a seller of September, but much less aggressively than earlier in the week, while the cash market was quiet.

There was a mixed response to monthly U.S. housing data. June housing starts rose 4.8 percent to a 1.452 million unit annual rate and the multi-family sector saw a 12.9 percent leap. There was concern, however, about a bearish 2.6 percent decline in June housing permits.
September lumber closed up $5.20 per thousand board feet at $360.50 with other months up $1.90 to off $0.10.
